name: example-dogfooding
description: The corpus this repository keeps about itself. Its subject is the repository it sits in rather than an invented estate, so a record here is wrong the moment that repository disagrees with it. It consumes Example Engineering the way any domain corpus consumes a governance layer.

components.note: Reads a term from corpus/glossary/terms.jsonl and the owning glossary record beside it.
Reads a clause from corpus/policies/clauses.jsonl and the owning policy beside it.
Reads a rule from corpus/standards/rules.jsonl and the owning standard beside it.
A SessionStart hook printing the breadcrumb rendered beside it, so a session learns the glossary is here before it has a term to look up.
